name: logseq-autocomplete
description: Autocomplete suggestions while typing in Logseq — powered by pages, tags, and a custom dictionary

logseq.title: Autocomplete
logseq.description: Suggests pages, tags, and dictionary words while you type

settings.title: Auto-expand on unique match
settings.description: When enabled and only one suggestion exists, it is inserted automatically.

settings.title: Suggestion Delay (ms)
settings.description: How long to wait after the last keystroke before querying suggestions (0–500).

settings.title: Min Interval (ms)
settings.description: Minimum time between repeated suggestion queries (0–500).

settings.title: Page Freq. Weight
settings.description: How much page usage frequency matters in ranking (0–1). 0 = match score only, 1 = frequency only.

settings.title: Tag Freq. Weight
settings.description: How much tag usage frequency matters in ranking (0–1). 0 = match score only, 1 = frequency only.

settings.title: Dict Freq. Weight
settings.description: How much dictionary-word usage frequency matters in ranking (0–1). 0 = match score only, 1 = frequency only.
